preconditions.description: The number of computers n is between 1 and 1500 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= a[i][j] <= (n * (n - 1)) // 2 for i in range(n) for j in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each difficulty value a_{i,j} is between 0 and (n * (n - 1)) // 2 inclusive.
The difficulty of sending data between a computer and itself is 0.

preconditions.expression: all(a[i][j] == a[j][i] for i in range(n) for j in range(n))
preconditions.description: The difficulty of sending data between computers i and j is the same as between j and i.

preconditions.expression: all(len(set(a[i][j] for j in range(n) if i != j)) == n - 1 for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: All difficulty values a_{i,j} for i < j are different.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n integers.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= result[k] < 998244353 for k in range(n))
postconditions.description: Each integer in the output is between 0 and 998244352 inclusive.
The k-th integer in the output is the number of ways to divide the computers into k+1 groups, modulo 998244353.
